evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames self-origination and possession as the appealed-to good, carrying both autonomy (own vs. rent) and self-enhancement (ownership as standing).

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Perspective-as-kept-asset appeals to self-origination (your perspective) and the craft-quality dimension of what you retain, positioning the individual's own viewpoint as durable value.

The compound label names the autonomy value directly — individual ownership as the thesis being positioned — but the segment is meta-commentary about positioning rather than performing the value move itself.

mints.name: OwnershipAsValueAxis
mints.title: owned vs. rented intelligence — possession of perspective as the retained asset
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to ownership and self-origination as the good that distinguishes what you keep from what you rent?
